package.name: h12_deploy_mjpc
package.description: MJPC deploy layer for the Unitree H1-2, rebuilt against pristine google-deepmind upstream mujoco_mpc (mjpc_reintegration branch). Links the standalone mjpc CMake build tree (container_cache/mjpc_build, built by docker/scripts/rebuild_mjpc.sh) directly — currently only the mjpc_smoketest link/model-load check plus an empty python seam; the deploy nodes (controller core, estimator) are reintegrated on top of this. The C++ section auto-skips when the mjpc build tree is absent.
